Fig. 2: Overview of the proposed positional calibration using IPS. Each document’s relevance score fθ(xi) is calibrated by multiplying it with estimated inverse propensity values πq(xi) to account for positional bias. The heatmap on the right visualizes the estimated inverse propensities across input and output positions.
